committed_delta_scope_observed.meaning: Only committed delta in inspected source/doc scope: a 20 ms SSE wakeup coalescing delay before reading persisted task events. No checkpoint or target implementation was added by that committed delta.

dirty_worktree_observation.caveat: Concurrent unpublished work existed. The ten reviewed files had identical before/after hashes during this observation window. This does not establish that all files were frozen, that no intermediate write occurred, or that this worktree matches any deployed service.

conclusions.finding: file_ready is emitted after the runner returns, before the task becomes completed; no mid-run complete code checkpoint was found in the reviewed path.
Generated file download reads the current context workspace. File listings contain path, size and modified_at, rather than an immutable multi-file revision/hash manifest.

The reviewed deployment schema still exposes none/server/agent and direct-run by code_path. No virtual preview execution target or immutable code Revision endpoint was found in the reviewed source/API document scope.

Context creation still requires device_id and client_id. If AI quota is enabled, accepting a coding task requires a MAC even when deploy_mode is none. This is a source-level conditional; live configuration and physical pairing were not checked.

device_data_reuse_and_separation.observed_new_capability: The dirty worktree contains device-data ingest, current data snapshot, and an ingest-notified dashboard SSE stream. It is incorrect to describe this worktree as lacking all realtime channels.
reusable_for_preview: Frontend snapshot subscription and display patterns, including an ingest-notified SSE wakeup and idle keepalive.
Owner-controlled share/revocation and dashboard presentation patterns can inform a preview adapter, subject to preview-specific authorization and runtime identity.
must_remain_separate: A reported sensor/channel value is not evidence that a specified virtual guest/controller or firmware consumed an input.

The data public_id/share identifies a dashboard capability; device_id/context_id identify existing AIFlow ownership resources. Neither substitutes for preview_id, run_id, revision_id, firmware/source SHA, or frozen Unit assembly/contract hashes.

Data channel version or sample seq is not a run generation or code revision. Every virtual preview event/frame/input must carry its actual run/revision identity, channel sequence/captured_at and trusted owner/control epoch.
Device-data SSE snapshot is mutable telemetry, not an immutable multi-file code checkpoint. It must not be relabeled as a ProgramRevision or inherit a previous run/source validation result.

Keep existing device reporting credentials and public share capabilities out of emulator source snapshots, global control-token exposure, evidence and browser source. Any future telemetry-to-preview binding must be explicit and owned by the same authorized run.

scope_and_safety.evidence_level: readonly source/doc observation; no new runtime or hardware PASS
